title: Unattended merge on green CI
summary: Squash-merges every pull request whose CI (and review, if any) is green, pinned to the validated commit; documentation too, never without CI. Never unattended: Claude instruction files, a CI Claude session's branch, a Dependabot bump the gate holds, and existing tests that lose lines once the project names its tests.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

PROJECT_GATE_RE.prompt: Paths of your own that are executed and never merge unattended (extended regular expression; ^$ adds none)

TEST_HOLD_RE.prompt: Paths of your tests: a pull request that deletes or rewrites their lines is held (extended regular expression; ^$ holds none)

MAJOR_HOLD_RE.prompt: Paths where an indirect Dependabot major is held (extended regular expression; . holds everywhere)

LIGHT_RUNNER.prompt: Runner label for the short jobs that need only bash, git, jq, the GitHub CLI and Node.js (ubuntu-latest keeps the 2-core runner; a self-hosted label works too)

postInstall: Before installing, check that GitHub enforces rulesets on this repository (on some plans a private repository only gets a warning on its Rulesets page): without one, do not use this module. Then protect the default branch with a ruleset: no direct push, a code-owner review required for .github/workflows/**, no bypass for GitHub Actions. A pull request runs its own copy of the workflows, so one that rewrites auto-merge.yml is judged by its own version: docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § Setting it up.

The workflow auto-merge waits for (the name given at install, "CI" by default) must exist under that exact `name:` and run on every pull request, with no `paths` or `paths-ignore` filter: a pull request it skips gets no run, and this workflow never merges it. Skip the costly jobs when only documentation changed with a `changes` job instead (the ci-workflow module ships one; docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § The CI workflow).

Three settings of .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml are values of the installation, set with `update <dir> --set KEY=<pattern>` and never by editing the workflow: PROJECT_GATE_RE, the paths of your own that are executed (with a row each in scripts/auto-merge-paths.txt — CLAUDE_GATE_RE is the kit's list, leave it); TEST_HOLD_RE, the paths of your tests (with `test` rows in the same file: until it is set, a pull request that deletes a failing test merges on green); MAJOR_HOLD_RE, where a Dependabot major is held (everywhere as shipped). Decide too whether something must be dispatched after a merge: that one is an edit of the workflow.

A merge made by this workflow emits no push event: anything that deploys or tests on push to the default branch will not run after it. docs/conventions/auto-merge-policy.md § After the merge says how to add a dispatch.
